EEBO Microfilm Duplicate Exposures Register (Reel 2646)

During the 20th-century microfilming of EEBO reel 2646 (ProQuest STC 2884 / British Library copy), 50 microfilm frames were photographed as redundant re-take exposures of physical pages already transcribed in this edition. In the original EEBO-TCP keying, these were marked with empty gap reason="duplicate" tags in the body text, which broke sentences mid-phrase. In this critical edition, those inline stubs have been removed to restore uninterrupted reading flow, and all 50 duplicate exposures are cataloged in the register below.
